should issues/UI/design.md:44,64,72 — Some cases are not covered:
- The temp-file name is not specified, so a crash could leave a file that matches the stored-file rule.
- The rule does not say what happens when the extension alone is over 120 bytes.
- Nothing says how a 50 MB multipart body is read: streamed to disk (MultipartReader) or held by ParseMultipartForm. On this memory-capped machine, several uploads at once could fill memory.
